Your palette

Main colors

Click a swatch to edit. Copy HEX or RGB for a custom fill.

Tints, shades & gradients

Each main color is an exact 50% anchor. Click a discrete sample to copy its HEX value; click a gradient to copy its stops.

Sequential

For ordered quantities. Lightness decreases from low to high.

Low / lightHigh / dark

Diverging

For data around a meaningful center, such as signed differences.

LowCenterHigh

Figure preview

Illustrative data only. Check the palette at the size of your final figure.

Line and marker styles

Readability checks

Contrast against white

3:1 is a useful review target for graphical elements; 4.5:1 is the WCAG minimum for ordinary text. These diagnostics do not certify an entire figure.

Series separation

    Grayscale preview is not a simulation of color vision deficiency. Use markers, line styles and labels; no colorblind-safe guarantee is made.

    Use the exports

    PowerPoint
    Open the editable toolkit and copy a swatch or gradient. Format Painter transfers the fill to your own shapes.
    For the theme: Design → Themes → Browse for Themes → palette.thmx. Office has six accent slots; all main colors remain in the toolkit.
    Origin
    Tools → Color Manager → Import from Files. Import main-colors.pal for categorical series, or a 256-color .pal for continuous colormaps.
    Set the actual data limits and the diverging midpoint in Origin; the palette file contains RGB values only.

    A figure’s colors, ready for your tools.

    01

    Pick the figure

    Upload a paper or an image, or paste a screenshot. Choose a PDF page and crop to the plot you like.

    02

    Shape your palette

    Keep the main colors, edit individual swatches and preview lines or heatmaps. Tints, shades and continuous scales update together.

    03

    Take it to your work

    Download editable PPTX and THMX files, Origin PAL presets, PNG/SVG cards and color values. The complete kit keeps everything together.
